frontierEnvelope: unchanged immutable V7 publication plus V20/V6 sourceOriginSample + window.ownedEndTarget * sourceRateHz / 16000; observations and window unchanged
observationOrder: sourceEventSample ascending then stable observationId code-unit order
duplicate: identical immutable content idempotent; mutated ID fails closed; no ID reassigned; bounded identity registry never evicts
sourceMapping: PracticeTimebase fixed sample anchor to same localSessionId, sampleIndex preserved; no transport/arrival clock/fit/compensation
replay: all immutable V15/V18 34 attempts across 22 cells; same prior paced epochs; ordinary evidence from production assembler only
replayInstanceBoundary: one assembler per frozen paced attempt with fixed source/session anchor; cell runtime persists; persistent-instance same-target and non-READY isolation are separately tested in production tests
truthRole: downstream physical classification only; never passed to assembler
stop: any per-row assembly/verdict divergence preserves failure and stops; never change H50 to fit evidence
